headline: Fix All Licenses — every grant baked into the signed files in one press
highlights: Manage Users counts the licenses whose grants live only online and re-signs them all with one press — today's allowed set, nobody's expiry shortened
Revoked and expired licenses are never touched, and the published directory is re-checked at press time, so a revocation made from the web always wins
The whole batch rides a single directory publish, and every fresh file is delivered online right away
